AAFC Outlook for Principal Field Crops (Canada)

outlook: Soybeans fell again Thursday, with November beans settling near $12.63 (down about 14 cents) as dry Midwest weather pushed the harvest to 46% done, even though USDA confirmed a second straight day of flash sales to China (330,000 tonnes). December corn eased about 3 cents to around $4.78 on harvest pressure and the bigger supply picture from the October WASDE, which put ending stocks at 1.849 billion bushels. Wheat gave back midday gains, with Minneapolis December spring wheat near $6.86 and Chicago December near $6.70, as a strong U.S. dollar weighed on export prospects. In Thursday evening trade, prices were little changed, and ICE November canola was at C$802.30.

news.title: Chicago soybeans fall on active harvests despite China buying demand
